teacherNotes.title: 5-Step Vocab Progression
teacherNotes.content: 1. Recognition -> 2. Pronunciation -> 3. Classification -> 4. Controlled Production -> 5. Personalised Use

teacherNotes.title: Core Words
teacherNotes.content: language, English, French, Italian, Russian, Greek, Spanish, German, speak, understand, well, a little, fluently, polyglot

elements.content: Core Active Vocabulary (10-20 items):
language, English, French, Italian, Russian, Greek, Spanish, German, speak, understand, well, a little, fluently, polyglot
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• What languages do you speak? (asking languages spoken)
• I speak English and a little French (stating language ability)
• I can speak... (expressing ability)
• I can't speak... (expressing lack of ability)
• Do you speak English? (asking language capability)

teacherNotes.title: Phonetic Aim
teacherNotes.content: Modal weak and strong forms: 'can' /kən/ in positive statements ('I can speak English'), 'can't' /kɑːnt/ or /kænt/ with stressed vowel in negatives.

elements.content: Pronunciation Focus:
Modal weak and strong forms: 'can' /kən/ in positive statements ('I can speak English'), 'can't' /kɑːnt/ or /kænt/ with stressed vowel in negatives.

teacherNotes.title: Function-First Grammar Rule
teacherNotes.content: Modal verb 'can' / 'cannot' ('can't') + bare infinitive verb. No '-s' for third person singular.

elements.content: Grammar System & Functional Framing:
Modal verb 'can' / 'cannot' ('can't') + bare infinitive verb. No '-s' for third person singular.
Examples:

• I can speak English.
• She can speak three languages.
• I can't speak Greek.
• Can you speak Italian?
• Yes, I can.
Reading Dialogue & Script:

Script using target language:
Person A: What languages do you speak?
Person B: I speak English and a little French
Listening Comprehension Prompt: Listen to the prompt and confirm understanding.

teacherNotes.title: Speaking Aim (~70%)
teacherNotes.content: Pair roleplay, information gap, and personalized speaking task.

elements.content: Communicative Speaking Task:
Practice with your partner: I can talk about languages I speak and state what I can and cannot do in a language.
Short Writing Task (~10%): Write 3-4 sentences in your notebook applying target chunks.

teacherNotes.title: Multi-Duration Strategy
teacherNotes.content: Choose 60m, 90m, or 120m flow based on scheduled class length.

elements.content: Timestamped Multi-Duration Flows:

• 60 min Flow (Essential): 0-10m Warm-up Language Quiz; 10-25m Language Vocab & Chunks; 25-40m Modal 'can/can't' Grammar; 40-55m Language Skills Survey; 55-60m Cool-down.

• 90 min Flow (Expanded): 0-10m Warm-up; 10-25m Vocab Expansion; 25-45m Modal Drills & Pronunciation; 45-65m Find Someone Who... Game; 65-85m Short Interview Reading; 85-90m Wrap-up.

• 120 min Flow (Full Workshop): 0-15m Icebreaker; 15-40m Phonetics /kən/ vs /kænt/; 40-70m Grammar System; 70-100m Multilingual Reception Roleplay; 100-115m Language CV Profile Writing; 115-120m Summary.
